summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing minutes of an Extraordinary General Meeting held April 27, 2026. Shareholders representing 97.79% of common and 77.75% of preferred shares approved amendments to the bylaws including changing the legal domicile to São Paulo, aligning digital meeting deadlines with CVM regulations, enhancing board replacement rules, adding an arbitration clause, and consolidating the bylaws. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no shareholder vote on a M&A or capital event. There are no deal terms, premiums, or advisors.
